cohort: Women aged 18-45 years seen in English hospitals between April 1, 2002 and March 31, 2019, including those with IIH, PCOS, and general population controls
finding: Women with a diagnosis of IIH had lower age-adjusted total pregnancy rates, increased risk of pre-eclampsia and gestational diabetes, and a doubling of elective caesarean section rates compared to general population controls.
mod_finding: Following a diagnosis of IIH, elective caesarean section rates were more than twice that of the general population.
